decisions.label: Device expert cache
decisions.brief: The device holds whole layers' experts, not a cache of the most used ones.
decisions.reason: a cache of experts on the device could hold 34935 MiB (34874 the capacity fitter gave 27 of 45 layers' experts, 60 it left free under one more whole layer), but CUDA0 does not execute this model's expert matmul on its own layout

decisions.label: Batch width
decisions.brief: 4096 tokens per pass: on this machine's own requests it is faster.
decisions.reason: measured on earlier loads: decode 13.89 tok/s at the full width against 18.36 at 4096, prefill of the prompts past 4096 at 0 against 0; a request here decodes 342 tokens and prefills 0 past 4096, so 24.63 s against 18.63, past the 10% margin

decisions.label: Layer placement
decisions.brief: 47 layers on a device; 18 of 45 layers keep their experts on the CPU.
decisions.reason: the capacity fitter found a placement that is projected to fit; 18 of 45 MoE layers keep their experts on the host, host-resident 418 MiB, on devices 45273 MiB, context 16384 (fitter's host breakdown: model 22571, context 34, compute 384 MiB; file 62542, experts 58124)

decisions.label: Context
decisions.brief: 16384 tokens of context, as given: not weighed against the cache.
decisions.reason: the value this run was given, not a choice: the capacity fitter only picks a context when it is handed a zero and this planner always pins it, so nothing has weighed this number against what the memory it reserves would buy as expert cache

decisions.label: Device layers
decisions.brief: 18 layers are split between a device and the CPU; the hops are unpriced.
decisions.reason: the capacity fitter put the dense part of 18 layers on a device and their experts on the host, two crossings a token each, and CUDA1 has not been shown to compute the host's results: the placement stands as the fitter made it

decisions.label: Streaming mode
decisions.brief: The whole model (23.1 GiB) fits in the 192.9 GiB usable.
decisions.reason: on the host 23696 MiB (dense 446) against 197574 MiB usable, which is the 246967 MiB this process may hold (as reported available, unmeasured) less a 49393 MiB margin (the process is killed)

decisions.label: Overlap I/O

decisions.reason: it acts on the expert streamer's own reads, and this plan does not stream: what is left on the host fits in this machine's residency budget; streaming it from flash would only add reads that resident weights do not need

decisions.label: Expert streaming

decisions.reason: the host residual fits: llama.cpp's placement is the whole plan

decisions.label: Compute threads
